instruction: A half-submerged sea grotto: a shell throne on a rock dais, drifting pearl strands, an opened giant clam with a glowing pearl, spilled treasure beneath turquoise water, shafts of light through a ceiling opening, swaying kelp and coral shelves, curious fish, bubbles rising, and rippling caustic light patterns dancing on the cave walls.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Mermaid Grotto. A half-submerged sea grotto: a shell throne on a rock dais, drifting pearl strands, an opened giant clam with a glowing pearl, spilled treasure beneath turquoise water, shafts of light through a ceiling opening, swaying kelp and coral shelves, curious fish, bubbles rising, and rippling caustic light patterns dancing on the cave walls. Style: iridescent aquatic fantasy. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
